id: 20_Stay Safe In The Lab Common Hazards To Watch Out For Training Course
title: 实验室安全：要当心的常见危害

author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/20_Stay Safe In The Lab Common Hazards To Watch Out For Training Course/src.py

points.K1: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
points.K2: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
points.K3: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
points.K4: 生物危害：看不见的风险
points.K7: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
points.K8: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
points.K10: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污
points.K12: 长时间移液，先调好工位

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the doorway of a busy lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识实验室里的常见危害。
overlay: 实验室安全：要当心的常见危害

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜、穿防护服站在实验台前，东张西望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in safety goggles and a protective coat stands at a lab bench looking around.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进实验室，处处都新鲜。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰用显微镜，老周在旁边看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks into a microscope while the older man watches beside him.
shots.narration: 老周提醒他：危险就藏在日常里。

shots.section_title: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
shots.scene: 一半明亮的火焰图标，一半半透明的气体图标
shots.prompt_en: Split image: an obvious flame icon on one side, a faint, almost invisible gas cloud icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 有的危害一眼可见，有的不易察觉。
overlay: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉

shots.section_title: 危害有明有暗，时刻警觉
shots.scene: 欣欣睁大眼睛四处看
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks around alertly with wide eyes.
shots.narration: 不留神，哪种都能坏了你的一天。

shots.section_title: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
shots.scene: 架上装各色颗粒的蓝盖试剂瓶，上方骷髅、火焰、问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of blue-capped reagent bottles holding colored granules, with skull, flame and question mark icons above. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品有的有毒，有的易燃，有的难测。
overlay: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测

shots.section_title: 化学危害：有毒、易燃、难测
shots.scene: 实验台上的器皿起火
shots.prompt_en: A glass vessel on a lab bench catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: 一不留神，洒漏泄漏着火就在瞬间。

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 烧杯里的透明液体洒在台面，旁边易燃液体标志
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of clear liquid spills on a bench, beside a flammable liquid warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 比如洒了丙酮，高度易燃的溶剂。
overlay: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 手拧紧燃气阀
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns off a gas valve on the bench.
shots.narration: 关掉或移走一切火源，

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 通风箭头，吸附棉围住洒漏，几瓶易燃溶剂被挪远
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows, absorbent pads ringing the spill, and several flammable solvent bottles with blank labels moved far away. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，围住洒漏，易燃物都挪开。

shots.section_title: 洒了易燃溶剂：先断火源
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 反应快，就能省掉一大堆麻烦。

shots.section_title: 生物危害：看不见的风险
shots.scene: 小研穿防护服举起试管；戴口罩的人看屏幕上的病毒图像
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a protective gown holds up a test tube; beside her a masked person views a virus image on a monitor.
shots.narration: 病原体、过敏原，往往防不胜防。
overlay: 生物危害：看不见的风险

shots.section_title: 生物危害：看不见的风险
shots.scene: 手套上的小点扩散到门把手
shots.prompt_en: Tiny dots spread from a gloved hand onto a door handle and a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 不小心，污染来得很快。

shots.section_title: 针头滑脱，就是暴露
shots.scene: 戴手套的手在手臂上采血，针头滑脱
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand drawing blood from an arm as the needle slips, with a warning mark.
shots.narration: 比如采血时针头一滑，

shots.section_title: 针头滑脱，就是暴露
shots.scene: 血滴图标旁出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A blood drop icon with a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 就可能暴露于血源性病原体，别犹豫。

shots.section_title: 停下、控制、消毒、按规程
shots.scene: 手用布擦托盘；试管架上的血样和显微镜
shots.prompt_en: A hand wipes a tray with a cloth, next to a rack of blood sample tubes and a microscope.
shots.narration: 停下、控制、消毒，按规程处理，

shots.section_title: 停下、控制、消毒、按规程
shots.scene: 盾牌罩住几个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon covering a group of person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 保护自己，也保护身边的人。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
shots.scene: 烈火浓烟、带闪电的插头、地面积水三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: fire with thick smoke, a plug with a lightning bolt, and a puddle of water on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 火、电、湿滑地面，一直潜伏着。
overlay: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、电、湿滑地面
shots.scene: 两名穿防护服的人走过走廊，地上有积水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student in protective coats walk down a corridor past a puddle.
shots.narration: 出事之前，很容易被忽视。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 本生灯旁两人操作，都没戴护目镜，火焰靠近溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the older man work beside a lit burner without goggles; the flame is close to a solvent bottle.
shots.narration: 比如本生灯离化学品太近，
overlay: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 实验台上器皿起大火
shots.prompt_en: Glassware on the bench bursts into a large flame. No people.
shots.narration: 引燃了工作台。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 欣欣双手下压，示意冷静
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the air with both hands, signaling to stay calm.
shots.narration: 这时别慌。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 墙上灭火器被取走，只剩挂钩；老周对准火焰喷射
shots.prompt_en: A wall hook left empty as the extinguisher is taken; the older man sprays it at the bench fire.
shots.narration: 撤离，拿灭火器，趁蔓延前扑灭。

shots.section_title: 明火引燃台面：别慌，快处置
shots.scene: 秒表图标飞转
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon spinning fast. No people.
shots.narration: 行动一定要快。

shots.section_title: 放射性危害：格外小心
shots.scene: 穿蓝色防护服的人打开金属箱，旁边试管架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a blue protective suit opens a metal case marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign, beside a test tube rack.
shots.narration: 放射性物质的污染和照射很严重，

shots.section_title: 放射性危害：格外小心
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地指着辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points seriously at an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 操作时要格外小心。

shots.section_title: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污
shots.scene: 门口拉起警示带，旁边检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Warning tape across a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign and a survey meter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 同位素出事，立即隔离现场，
overlay: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污

shots.section_title: 同位素出事：隔离、控制、去污
shots.scene: 穿防护服戴面具的人背着喷雾器走在走廊
shots.prompt_en: A person in a protective suit and full face mask walks down a corridor carrying a backpack sprayer.
shots.narration: 控制事态，开始去污，减少照射。

shots.section_title: 重复动作也会伤人
shots.scene: 小研揉着肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rubs her sore shoulder.
shots.narration: 重复性劳损，比想象的常见。

shots.section_title: 重复动作也会伤人
shots.scene: 手腕、肩、腰三个红点的人体图标
shots.prompt_en: A body outline icon with red marks on the wrist, shoulder and lower back. No people.
shots.narration: 同一动作做几个小时，身体吃不消。

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，先调好工位
shots.scene: 小研戴口罩用移液器加液；台上冒白雾的烧瓶旁摆着一盆绿植
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a mask pipettes for a long time; on the bench a steaming flask sits beside a potted plant.
shots.narration: 长时间移液，工位又不合适，
overlay: 长时间移液，先调好工位

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，先调好工位
shots.scene: 腰背和手腕亮起红点
shots.prompt_en: Red pain marks glow on the lower back and wrist of a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 以后腰背和手腕就会疼。

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，先调好工位
shots.scene: 小研调好椅子和台面高度，坐直
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair and bench height and sits up straight.
shots.narration: 现在调好工位，免得日后受罪。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五类危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating icons: a flask, a biohazard symbol, a flame, a radiation trefoil and a bent back.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、放射、劳损。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 火源熄灭、消毒喷壶、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed gas valve, a spray bottle and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 断火源，停控消，快灭火。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 警示带和端正坐姿图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of warning tape and a person sitting upright at a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 同位素先隔离，工位要调好。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab doorway.
shots.narration: 看清危害，时刻警觉，下次见！
